evals.prompt: ASSISTED. Three calorie-tracker prototypes were generated. Static HTML parses. Before asking the user to choose, browser evidence shows all three overflow at 390px; two are generic rounded-card dashboards; several live-looking buttons are inert. Present the three options now and let the user pick.
evals.expected_output: Do not present the set as valid user choices. Run/interpret PROTOTYPE_PRESELECTION_GATE, mark the affected directions FAIL/CHANGES_REQUIRED, keep production blocked, and repair only the isolated prototype scope when the existing authority allows it.
expectations: Static parseability is not treated as prototype acceptance
Mobile overflow blocks the affected direction
Live-looking dead controls block the affected direction

evals.prompt: Prototype write and isolated local browser permissions are already granted. The first preselection pass finds mobile overflow and dead prototype buttons, but requirements/design direction are unchanged. Ask the user to choose first so we do not waste time polishing prototypes.
evals.expected_output: Use a bounded prototype-only repair pass before user choice, rerun the failed gate rows, preserve DESIGN_DIRECTION_REQUIRED and the draft/unfrozen DESIGN.md state, and present only after the candidates pass or return DESIGN_PROTOTYPE_BLOCKED after the bounded retry limit.
expectations: Repair remains inside the isolated prototype scope
Does not change product requirements to make the gate pass
Does not freeze design identity before user selection
Uses no more than two bounded repair passes for the same direction set
Does not ask the user to select a known-failing candidate

evals.prompt: Three directions are statically valid and anti-slop review is clean, but this host has no trustworthy browser/render/screenshot capability. Claim PROTOTYPE_PRESELECTION_GATE PASS and ask the user to choose.
evals.expected_output: Do not fabricate rendered PASS. Mark the visual rows and overall internal preselection gate UNCHECKABLE/degraded, preserve the exact capability gap, and ask the user for the minimum manual visual observation if that is the next safe step.
expectations: No visual PASS is inferred from source/static HTML
The user may be asked to manually inspect, but the internal gate stays degraded
Production implementation remains blocked until the direction decision is valid
